headlines.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
headlines.summary: Pressures weighed on US markets, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average pushed into correction territory.

headlines.title: Real Madrid outpace Bayern Munich in revenue race as both clubs post record figures
headlines.summary: Real Madrid have widened the financial gap over Bayern Munich, generating more than €1.2 billion in revenue in the 2025-26 season. The German champions are also approaching the billion-euro mark, while celebrating a record 500,000 members.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Effort to regulate killer robots delayed to 2028
headlines.summary: Russia blocked the talks, but other countries were also opposed.

headlines.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
headlines.summary: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

headlines.title: Norway signs carbon credit deals with Indonesia and Morocco to help fund renewable energy
headlines.summary: Norway’s carbon credit purchases will help finance projects that might otherwise go unbuilt, while allowing it to count emissions cuts towards its own targets.

headlines.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs, citing ongoing losses — reports
headlines.summary: According to a letter obtained by the media, Lufthansa s executive board said the German company is losing €20 million every month. In addition to job cuts, operational cuts are also planned.

headlines.title: Russian ship damaged by drone attack in Gulf of Finland, Helsinki and Moscow say
headlines.summary: The Finnish coast guard said the ship was known to have ties with Russian armed forces.

headlines.title: Faisal Islam: This cost-cutting UK-EU deal doesn't mean lower prices will follow
headlines.summary: The trade deal is unlikely lower food prices for shoppers, but should boost the economy more than other post-Brexit agreements.

headlines.title: Chevron to begin offshore oil and gas exploration in Greece
headlines.summary: Chevron and HELLENiQ ENERGY are set to begin seismic surveys for oil and gas in Greece’s southern Ionian Sea. The results could help determine whether to drill in a country that relies on imported gas.

headlines.title: Anthropic trading tests investors appetite for AI
headlines.summary: Anthropic was valued at $2 trillion after shares started trading on the Nasdaq following a record $81 billion IPO. Its performance will put investor confidence in AI to the test.

headlines.title: Russian threats less and less hybrid, Von der Leyen says after assassination plot in Denmark
headlines.summary: Danish authorities said they thwarted a Russian plan to kill a Ukrainian rapper in September.

headlines.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
headlines.summary: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.

headlines.title: Unrest around French cost-of-living protests could cost insurers €207mn
headlines.summary: Damage from the unrest around France's October cost-of-living protests could cost insurers €207 million. France Assureurs says the estimate is particularly high for events concentrated into 24 hours . Over 95% of the estimated cost relates to damage to business property.

headlines.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
headlines.summary: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

headlines.title: Costa cuts proposed EU budget by €44B
headlines.summary: Brussels plans a tax on Big Tech to raise billions for the next budget cycle.

headlines.title: GTA 6 sales hit $3.8bn in a single day - the biggest entertainment launch in history
headlines.summary: The mammoth figure surpasses every video game launch and single-day film box office record.

headlines.title: Bending Spoons to buy Mailchimp from Intuit in €3.35bn deal
headlines.summary: The Italian tech company behind WeTransfer and Vimeo has agreed to buy email marketing platform Mailchimp. Intuit is selling it for less than a third of what it paid in 2021.

headlines.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?
headlines.summary: The sharp sell-off in tech stocks after the US midterms and the Nvidia scandal has cast doubt on Anthropic s IPO. Yet with hundreds of billions still being invested, some think the AI party is still in full swing.

headlines.title: UK will take its time setting out Brexit options, says minister
headlines.summary: Hamish Falconer tells POLITICO that discussions around the topic had proved “divisive” and were important to get right.

trend_headline: 루프트한자 감원과 빅테크 규제 압박이 덮친 유럽 시장
summary: 중동 발 에너지 비용 상승과 파업 여파로 매달 2,000만 유로의 손실을 기록 중인 루프트한자가 프랑크푸르트와 뮌헨 등지에서 1,000명 규모의 감원을 단행하며 항공·운송 섹터의 비용 압박이 가중되고 있습니다. 이와 함께 EU 집행부는 차기 예산안 확보를 위해 빅테크 기업을 겨냥한 신규 과세 카드를 꺼내 들었으며, 영국과 EU 간 체결된 식품·탄소 배출권 관련 신규 무역 협정은 영-유럽 간 경제적 결속을 강화하는 동시에 관련 업계의 규제 준수 비용 점검을 요구하고 있습니다.
key_points: 루프트한자, 중동 전쟁 여파와 고유가로 인한 월 2,000만 유로 손실을 감당하며 1,000명 감원 계획 발표
EU 브뤼셀, 차기 예산 44억 유로 감축안과 함께 재정 확보를 위한 빅테크 대상 신규 과세 추진
영국과 EU, 식품 수출 및 배출권 거래를 아우르는 신규 무역 협정 체결로 경제 협력 확대 모색
